merged_table_columns.effect: The exact standalone row-code lookup cannot match the code appended to its label. The source-row audit is separate and does not repair the table or its original pass flag.

text_region_limit: region_text includes horizontally intersecting whole recognized lines. A source-right shift label merged with the sale heading can therefore add characters outside the intended source text. Raw CER is retained without trimming or rescoring.
field_score_limit: A field passes when its normalized number is present in its source-region text and somewhere in the exported document. This does not independently prove that the exported number retains its correct semantic field label.
scope: Selected-region stress evaluation. Headings, chosen numeric rows and fields only; not full-document character accuracy or a representative population estimate.
